The user is already logged in to the web app at http://localhost:5173. Please navigate there and thoroughly investigate for visual and functional issues.

2. Open the browser developer console (F12) and note any JavaScript errors or warnings

7. Check if the sidebar navigation works correctly (hover expand, active states)
